title: Cloud Security: encryption operations
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for encryption operations.

## Basis

Key operation rate: Managed encryption key operations; USD per thousand operations.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Key operation rate |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 0.0031 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 0.0031 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 0.0031 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 0.0031 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 0.0031 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 0.0031 |

## Tier comparison

The listed encryption operations bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
